units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 2:4:5">Y. Kidd. II, 62ᵈ</cite> <he>דמטמרא לה תחות קלוסיתה דראשה</he> (corr. acc.) she had hidden it (her blemish) under her head-dress.

senses.gloss: belt. Y. Sebu. VI, 37ᵃ bot. והוה … דקוּלְסִיתָהּ וכ׳ she had two Denars tied up between the folds of her belt.
